Resume tips for PwC

  • Highlight measurable client or project impact ahead of task descriptions, consistent with PwC’s consulting resume expectations.
  • List relevant certifications (CA, CPA, PMP, cloud) prominently near the top.
  • For tech consulting roles, balance technical stack knowledge with business communication skills.
  • Keep the tone professional and the layout conservative and ATS-clean.

Frequently asked questions

Does PwC use an ATS to screen resumes?

PwC’s ATS filters on both domain keywords and certifications, with recruiters placing significant weight on academic performance and case-study reasoning ability.

What are PwC's typical interview rounds?

Most candidates go through: Online Assessment → Case Study/Group Discussion → Partner/Manager Interview → HR Round.
